data.name: Veilbound
data.detailed_description:
After awakening from an almost eternal slumber, Usagi Ginsui returns to Zentai — a world now fractured into two overlapping realms. Drawn into a war between the Veilguard and the Traitor Army, Usagi must find a way to survive ,uncover the truth behind the world’s slow descent into ruin and in the end try to save it. Play as Usagi and Survive in this Story-Rich RPG set in a realm of myth and mystery. Explore the shattered lands of Zentai camouflaged as a Veilbound, forge alliances with powerful factions and interesting creatures, aid those in need, and leave a lasting mark on a world hanging by a thread.
Will you rise to become the hero this world needs in its darkest hour? Or will you discover that not all stories are as one-sided as they seem?

Explore
Venture into different biomes and locations and unveil the secrets of this land. Gather resources and find dungeons and complete puzzles in order to improve your gear.

Survive
Make great use of your resources in order to survive. Eat, sleep, craft, avoid the harsh weather and watch out for the enemies that lurk around the corner.

Fight
Use a variety of skills and weapons in order to defeat your enemies. Improve your gear. choose your playstyle and become the great Guardlan of this land. Engage In epic boss fights, explore dungeons and defend your home.

Build
Create your custom base, be it a shack or a palace. Set your defences in order to protect agains the evil yokal that will raid your home.

Live development
You can follow the development of the game live. We will welcome your ideas and contribution!

data.short_description: Veilbound is a Survival RPG set in a fantasy world inspired by Japanese culture, multiple mythologies, and deep philosophies. Follow Usagi Ginsui as you fight, explore, and uncover the truth behind a realm on the brink of collapse. Can Zentai’s balance be restored?
